assets.name: Needle Pilgrim

canonical.anatomy: A body no wider than a compass needle balances beneath layered robes.
canonical.locomotion: It falls eastward, catches itself, and calls the sequence walking.
canonical.sound: Salt grains scrape in a single unchanging direction.
canonical.purpose: It etches directional grooves that guide other pilgrims deeper into the basin.
canonical.origin: A guide trusted a broken compass until his body adopted its only remaining bearing.
canonical.cue: Its needle body tilts while the eastern robe edge lifts.
canonical.counterplay: Move west through the fall and strike before it rights itself.

assets.masterDirection: Show one mature layered pilgrim robe suspended and balanced around exactly one continuous compass-needle-thin mirror-blue body, with no ordinary torso, pelvis, arms, legs, hands, or feet hidden inside. The single needle body must remain visibly the same hair-thin width from pointed upper tip to pointed lower contact tip while the heavy salt-crusted robe layers cantilever around it. Pose the needle tilted in a committed fall toward viewer-right, defined as east only by the motion, while exactly the viewer-right outer robe edge lifts sharply and salt grains scrape in that same one direction as a sparse subject-bound streak. The opposite robe edge hangs lower, leaving a clear westward passage through the fall. The lower needle point is poised to catch and right the body in empty space. No compass rose, letter, map, terrain groove, ground, ordinary pilgrim anatomy, extra needle, face, weapon, or scene.

assets.name: Compass Slug

canonical.anatomy: Four eyestalks end in cardinal letters that constantly exchange places.
canonical.locomotion: It slides toward the direction it has just lost.
canonical.sound: A faint surveyor's chain drags beneath its salt trail.
canonical.purpose: It randomizes old route marks so the false horizon remains uncontested.
canonical.origin: Survey ink spilled into brine and grew a soft body around the map's compass rose.
canonical.cue: One cardinal eye goes blank and points behind the target.
canonical.counterplay: Stand on the erased letter in its trail to reverse the slide.

assets.masterDirection: Show one low mature mirror-salt slug in a complete lateral slide with EXACTLY FOUR long eyestalks. At each eyestalk tip, integrate one small sunless-gold framed marker slot. Three slots contain three distinct simple nonalphabetic cardinal-position notches visibly exchanging places through restrained crossing hinge tracks; EXACTLY ONE slot is completely blank and its entire eyestalk bends backward behind the slug as the lost-bearing cue. From the tail, attach one flat salt-trail ribbon suspended as subject anatomy rather than a floor. The ribbon repeats the three nonalphabetic notch positions and has one clearly erased blank socket aligned with the backward blank eye, making the reversal target readable. A small plain surveyor chain remains attached beneath the body and trail without touching terrain. Keep exactly four eyestalks, one blank eye, three marked eyes, one erased trail socket, and the full body visible. No real N/E/S/W letters, readable writing, compass rose, map, ground, ordinary shell, extra slug, bright reflection, or scene.

assets.name: Eastward Witness

canonical.anatomy: Every facial feature has migrated to the right side of an otherwise blank head.
canonical.locomotion: It circles until all observers stand west of it.
canonical.sound: Testimony is whispered only into the downwind ear.
canonical.purpose: It confirms false landmarks by ensuring everyone sees them from one direction.
canonical.origin: A boundary witness altered his testimony so often that truth retreated to one side of his face.
canonical.cue: Its crowded features turn toward a mirage no one else can see.
canonical.counterplay: Cross to its eastern side where it cannot maintain a witness.

canonical.cue: White bands extend from its sections across the arena.
canonical.counterplay: Move north or south between bands, then attack the section that lags.
